body.cta_section_text: IGENXT runs technical SEO audits for UAE businesses and fixes performance, schema and indexation issues.

content_blocks.content:
Search engines must crawl and index your pages correctly. Check robots.txt, XML sitemaps and canonical tags. Ensure important pages are not blocked and that staging environments are not indexable.

  • Submit an XML sitemap in Google Search Console.
  • Fix 404 errors and redirect chains.
  • Use canonical URLs on paginated and filtered views.
  • Monitor coverage reports for excluded pages.

content_blocks.text: Core Web Vitals and mobile performance

content_blocks.content:
UAE users browse heavily on mobile. Slow sites lose rankings and conversions. Target strong LCP, INP and CLS scores. Use modern hosting, image optimisation and lean JavaScript.

IGENXT builds on Next.js and Vercel with performance budgets from day one. Our Moduluxe Group case study achieved 0.8s load times and 95% performance scores after rebuild.

content_blocks.caption: Technical SEO and Core Web Vitals support both rankings and user experience.

content_blocks.content:
UAE sites often serve English and Arabic. Implement hreflang links between language versions, use proper lang attributes and test RTL layouts. Avoid serving the wrong language based on IP alone without user control.

See our bilingual website development guide for implementation patterns.

Add schema for Organization, LocalBusiness (where accurate), Service, FAQPage and Article where relevant. Valid JSON-LD helps search engines understand your content and can enable rich results.

Test markup with Google Rich Results Test and fix warnings before launch.

Technical SEO is not a one-off audit. Schedule quarterly reviews of Search Console, broken links, security (HTTPS), and page speed. Pair technical work with local SEO and quality content for compounding results.

body.faq_description: Technical SEO questions for UAE website owners.

faqs.question: What Core Web Vitals scores should I aim for?
faqs.answer: Aim for LCP under 2.5 seconds, INP under 200ms and CLS under 0.1 for a good user experience. Higher scores correlate with better engagement and can support SEO performance.

faqs.question: Is hreflang required for UAE bilingual sites?
faqs.answer: Hreflang is strongly recommended when you publish distinct English and Arabic URLs. It helps Google serve the correct language version to users and reduces duplicate content confusion.

faqs.question: How often should I run a technical SEO audit?
faqs.answer: Run a full audit at launch, after major site changes and at least quarterly. Monitor Search Console weekly for new crawl or indexation issues.

faqs.question: Can you fix SEO issues on WordPress sites?
faqs.answer: Yes. We audit and improve WordPress, headless and Next.js sites. We also help businesses migrate to Next.js when performance and scalability require it.
